name: ALLIED RESOURCING
india_angle: Adepth Consulting Engineers, a division of Allied Resourcing, is based in Chennai, India, and provides high-tech scientific instruments to premier Indian R&D institutions.
summary: Allied Resourcing, through its division Adepth Consulting Engineers, supplies high-tech equipment and instruments for advanced R&D applications, including semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include photomasks, laser direct imagers, and systems for 2D material detection, catering to the needs of semiconductor and microelectronics research and development.
